description:
Protect your cargo with a heavy-duty FRP hard tri-fold tonneau cover. Built for durability, easy no-drill installation, and everyday weather protection, its folding design provides convenient bed access.
Features
Heavy-Duty FRP Construction: Built with reinforced fiberglass (FRP) panels, this hard tri-fold tonneau cover delivers durable strength and reliable load-bearing performance for everyday truck bed use.
Quick No-Drill Installation: Designed for a hassle-free setup, the FRP truck bed cover installs with included hardware and clear instructions—no drilling required. Note: Cargo racks must be removed before installation.
All-Weather Cargo Protection: The hard panels help shield your truck bed cargo from rain, snow, road debris, impacts, and sharp objects, providing dependable protection for everyday hauling and travel.
Tri-Fold Design for Easy Access: The folding truck bed cover opens and folds conveniently when you need access to your cargo, while allowing you to quickly cover the bed when cargo protection is needed.
Convenient Nighttime Visibility: A complimentary LED light helps illuminate the truck bed after dark, making it easier to see and access your cargo in low-light conditions.
1-year Warranty. For your safety, professional installation is recommended.
Fitment
Compatible with 2002-2026 Dodge Ram 1500 (Inclu. Classic & New), 2003-2026 Dodge Ram 2500 3500 with 6.4 Feet Bed w/o Ram Box

Reinforced Strength & Load Capacity: High-strength FRP panels provide a solid, durable construction with impressive load-bearing capability, helping the cover withstand everyday demands.
Reliable Everyday Cargo Protection: The hard FRP panels help shield your cargo from rain, snow, road debris, impacts, and sharp objects for dependable protection on daily drives.
